LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_HydraulicFracturing.label: hydraulic fracturing
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_HydraulicFracturing.descri:
Ultra-high-pressure fluid tears the deep bedrock apart and frees the hydrocarbons and rare volatiles trapped in fissures in the crust. Even long after the surface deposits are exhausted, it keeps drawing chemfuel and minerals from underground. The mineral-laden slurry the process discharges, however, leaves severe heavy-metal pollution all around it.
As a means of resource extraction its industrial efficiency is extremely high, but spreading the technique across industrial worlds that lack environmental ethics can degrade a planet's living conditions rapidly, to the point that it is no longer habitable.

Approved by ████ and ██, hydraulic fracturing extraction and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Sale of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and its related technologies are to be progressively declassified once a colonial world's society attains class I standard.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_HydraulicFracturing.discov:
Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology: an extraction method that splits deep bedrock open with ultra-high-pressure fluid.

The hydraulic fracturing rig can now be built. It mines the deep deposits around it automatically and, once they are exhausted, draws chemfuel and steel from the bedrock, at the cost of polluting the surrounding ground.

The fleets sealed this file so that the worlds it touches would still be fit to live on afterward.
